claims.text: Narrow-band UVB or soak PUVA (hands or feet soaked in a psoralen solution before UVA exposure)
claims.quote: Phototherapy with narrow-band ultraviolet B (UVB) or with soak PUVA (in which patients soak their hands and/or feet in a psoralen solution before exposure to UVA) can help.
claims.locator: Treatment of Hand and Foot Dermatitis
